description: AKS API server request rate, latency, errors and etcd latency (requires AKS control plane metrics in Azure managed Prometheus)

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: API requests per second

panels.title: 5xx Error Rate
panels.description: Share of API requests returning 5xx

panels.title: P99 Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile request latency, excluding WATCH and CONNECT

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[5m])))) or (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Throttled (429) /s
panels.description: Requests rejected by API Priority and Fairness or rate limiting

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate(apiserver_request_total{cluster=~"$cluster", code="429"}[5m])) or sum by (cluster) (rate(apiserver_request_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])) * 0

panels.title: Etcd P99 (from API server)
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of API server calls to etcd

panels.title: Etcd Has Leader
panels.description: 1 = the etcd cluster has an elected leader

panels.title: Requests by Verb
panels.description: API requests per second by verb

panels.title: Requests by Response Code
panels.description: API requests per second by status class

panels.title: Top $topn Resources by Request Rate
panels.description: Busiest API resources. A sudden spike usually points to a misbehaving controller or operator.

panels.title: Request Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 latency of non-long-running requests (WATCH and CONNECT excluded)

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval])))) or (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval]))))

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval])))) or (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval]))))

(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval])))) or (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: P99 Latency by Verb
panels.description: Mutating verbs (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) are normally slower than reads

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, verb, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval])))) or (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, verb, le) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Slowest Requests (P99, last 5m)
panels.description: Resource + verb combinations with the highest 99th percentile latency

targets.expr: topk(20, (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, verb, resource, subresource, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[5m])))) or (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, verb, resource, subresource, le) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[5m])))) > 0)
sum by (cluster, verb, resource, subresource) (rate(apiserver_request_total{cluster=~"$cluster", verb!~"WATCH|CONNECT"}[5m]))

panels.title: Error Rate %
panels.description: 5xx = API server failures. 429 = throttled by API Priority and Fairness.

panels.title: Errors by Code
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx responses per second by status code

panels.title: Top $topn Resources by 5xx
panels.description: Resources returning server errors

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (cluster, verb, resource) (rate(apiserver_request_total{cluster=~"$cluster", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: API Server → Etcd Latency
panels.description: P50 / P99 of every etcd call the API server makes

panels.title: Etcd P99 by Operation
panels.description: get / list / create / update / delete as seen by the API server

panels.title: Etcd P99 by Object Type (top $topn)
panels.description: Slowest object types. Large lists of secrets/configmaps/events are typical culprits.

targets.expr: topk($topn, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, type, le) (rate(etcd_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Etcd Disk Latency (P99)
panels.description: WAL fsync should stay under ~10 ms and backend commit under ~25 ms

panels.title: Etcd Database Size
panels.description: Total vs in-use size. A large gap means the DB needs defragmenting (Azure manages this).

panels.title: Etcd Health Events
panels.description: Leader changes, slow applies and heartbeat failures in each interval

title: API Server – AKS
